## Findings

- `--red-pen` on `--paper` is below 4.5:1, so red-pen is **large text (≥24px) or
  non-text only** on paper. The 61px death number qualifies; body-size red text does not.
- DESIGNING.md states two ratios slightly differently from the computed values (both
  still pass):

| Pairing | DESIGNING.md says | Computed |
|---|---|---|
| `--ink` on `--paper` | 11.2:1 | 11.68:1 |
| `--marigold` on `--carbon` | 9.1:1 | 9.20:1 |

## Not covered by this audit

- Colour-blind check of `--red-pen` vs `--marigold` on `--carbon` under deuteranopia and
  protanopia (DESIGNING.md §5). Needs a manual simulation pass once real sprites exist.
